text:
name: rag_knowledge_base
question: >-
  Independently, per model, research the state of the art in runtime retrieval-augmented
  generation for AI agents, then design and propose an "agent intelligent knowledge base":
  (1) where the agent knowledge lives (Neo4j graph vs ChromaDB vectors vs Redis stream vs
  Elasticsearch, or a hybrid), (2) how a work item is augmented at runtime from that store,
  and (3) a prompt-constructor agent that turns a raw work item into an optimally augmented
  prompt. Each of deepseek-v4-pro, claude-fable-5, and gpt-5.6-sol researches and proposes
  independently, in its own worktree, grounded in this repo's existing infra and the external
  cutting edge. Output per cell is a proposal + integration/impact plan.
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true   # chain the 3 phases' sessions so shared context becomes DeepSeek cache reads
